fc37cfe8-cdda-494b-a7e7-b1027cc31796.message: Hello! My name is Luna. I am calling on behalf of Microware. This call is in regards to our in house survey on Covid. May I ask you a few questions?
Could you please state your full name?

Hi there! Thanks for sharing your name, but we're looking for your full name — first and last. Please provide a response with at least two space-separated alphabetic words, each starting with a letter and having at least two letters. For example, 'Alex Johnson' or 'Emily Brown'.
